name: The Bloody Dagger Tavern
desc1: This nasty-looking tavern is filled with all manner of rowdy,
desc2: suspicious-looking people. Fistfights are common here, as are knife
desc3: fights, and at least once a day blood has to be mopped from the floor
desc4: because someone did not survive. Two doors lead out of this tavern,
desc5: one to the west, onto Shadow street, and one to the south, onto Flame
